intro.text: Soldiers in Elend's army who stayed sick longest after the mists struck them, shunned by their comrades and gathered into a division of their own.
Soldiers in Elend's army who stayed sick longest after the mists struck them, gathered into a division of their own. Their long sickness marks them as atium Mistings, the most powerful kind.

description.text: Noorden works out that exactly sixteen percent of any group meeting the mists for the first time falls sick.
One in sixteen of those who fall sick either stay ill for sixteen days or die.

The sickness was part of Preservation's plan: the mists struck people to snap them, raising their Allomantic potential, and Ruin's meddling made them deadly to the weak. Sixteen, matching the number of Allomantic metals, was a clue Preservation left where Ruin could not change it.

items.text: Those whose sickness lasted longest are shunned by the rest of the army, so Elend has Demoux gather them into a division of their own.

Other soldiers call the mistfallen cursed, and brawls break out; a soldier named Bilg even attacks Demoux and is executed for it. Elend sends Demoux and the mistfallen back to Luthadel to help King Penrod.

In Fadrex, Elend sees that the mist sickness resembles the beatings that snap Allomancers. He has a mistfallen soldier drink a vial of metals, and the man burns metal: the mists have been making Allomancers, not harming them.
Reaching the Pits of Hathsin, Elend comes upon Demoux and his mistfallen division.
Elend realises they were sick longest because they are atium Mistings. Demoux and his men fight the attacking koloss with atium, buying Elend time and burning away Ruin's body.
